channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Score big on romance: Three books to read after Heated Rivalry
item.description: If Heated Rivalry stole your heart with its sizzling chemistry, emotional depth, and the irresistible tension between rivals, you’re in luck.

item.title: Anti-trafficking sting nets 105 arrests across county
item.description: The effort netted a total of 120 arrests: 87 arrested for loitering, 25 for solicitation, and eight for pimping and pandering.

item.title: Pacific Beach Town Council honorary mayor and others at annual dinner
item.description: Since its founding in 1951, PBTC’s installation and awards dinner invites participation from all of the elected officials representing PB.

item.title: California ramps up food access efforts
item.description: The California Association of Food Banks reports as much as a 40% increase in demand for food compared to last year at this time.

item.title: ‘Warmth with compassion’: Casa Cornelia hosts coat, blanket drive through Feb. 28
item.description: Casa Cornelia Law Center is hosting a coat and blanket drive through Feb. 28 to support clients and community partners serving people facing winter without basic necessities.

item.title: 10,000 air purifiers distributed to combat toxic gas odors in South Bay
item.description: In a little less than a year, an air purifier program to protect the health of South Bay residents has distributed more than 10,000 devices to mitigate the effects of hydrogen sulfide odors.

item.title: Border Patrol Commander Greg Bovino returning to El Centro amid federal shake-up
item.description: Border Patrol commander Greg Bovino has been removed from his role as “commander at large” and will return to his former post in El Centro, neighboring San Diego County, where he is expected to retire soon, according to a Department of Homeland Security official and two people familiar with the decision.

item.title: Goodbye fax machines: Supervisors propose $7 million annual cost-saving comms
item.description: San Diego County Supervisors Terra Lawson-Remer and Monica Montgomery Steppe unveiled a proposal Monday to modernize county communications technology and save taxpayers up to $7 million annually.

item.title: Upgraded accessible baseball field in Del Mar reopens as Padres Park
item.description: "Root, root, root for the home team" as San Diego County officially reopened and renamed the former Miracle Field to Padres Park at San Dieguito Park in Del Mar.

item.title: A year into Trump administration’s arrests, separated families struggle to stay afloat
item.description: In 2025, over 5,000 people were deported in the San Diego area, leaving countless parents, children torn.
